jobs.title: Learn more : Product Manager
jobs.description: Product Manager | Careers at QIZ Skip to content Home Company Careers Book a Demo Contact us BOOK A DEMO BOOK A DEMO Back to all positions Product Manager Location: Israel Department: Product Type: Full-time Model: Hybrid What You’ll Do Customer-Centric Discovery: Engage directly with customers to translate operational pains into confidence-building product value. Planning and Prioritization: Own the roadmap and backlog. Ruthlessly prioritize between urgent customer needs, technical debt, and long-term PQC readiness goals. Define the Journey: Design end-to-end workflows that guide the user through the entire operational lifecycle, from discovery to resolution. Define with Precision: Don’t just list features. Go deep enough into the technical and regulatory detail to define clear, well-scoped requirements — so engineering can own the implementation with full context. R&D Partnership: Provide clear business intent and user context, trusting engineering with the architecture. What You Bring Experience: 5+ years in B2B Enterprise Software or SaaS. Technical Fluency: You can read API documentation and technical standards (RFCs). You are comfortable navigating technical tools to find answers rather than waiting for a demo. AI-Augmented Workflow: You use modern AI tools to accelerate research, draft specifications, and analyze data. Cyber Context: Strong domain expertise in Security, Infrastructure, or Compliance. Application Security background a pro. Outcome-Driven Mindset: You focus on the value and the outcome (e.g., risk reduction, operational readiness), not just the feature. You understand that shipping code is secondary to solving the customer’s true business problem.
